item.title: Inner Body Meditation (20 minutes) — Thu Aug 27, 9:30 PM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream "Awareness of the inner body takes you beyond the mind." - Eckhart Tolle
In this mediation session we will bring our attention here: to the inner body. Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teachings and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous. They will last around 20 minutes and cameras and microphones will be disabled. (Depending on the situation, a free discussion may be held at the end with mics and cameras allowed.)
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys also organises a free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group. Visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/) for more information.21
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: (Bloomfield Campus) National Voter Registration Day: Race to the Ballot — Wed Sep 16, 12:00 PM — Deacon's Den and Talbott Hall Quad
item.description: Join thousands of colleges, universities, nonprofits, businesses, and community organizations across the country as we celebrate National Voter Registration Day—the nation's largest single-day voter registration effort. This annual, nonpartisan initiative brings Americans together with one shared goal: helping eligible voters get registered, informed, and prepared to participate in our democracy. Join us on September 17 from 12:00–4:00 PM in the Student Center Ballrooms and Quad as Montclair State University celebrates this national movement with an afternoon of civic engagement, entertainment, and community. This year's event is proudly presented in collaboration with the Office of Commuter Life as part of Commuter Life Appreciation Week (CLAW). Together, we're celebrating the important role commuter students play in our campus community while encouraging every Red Hawk to become an informed and engaged participant in our democracy. item.title: Free Swim Lessons *Beginner* — Wed Sep 16, 5:00 PM — Student Recreation Center Pool
item.description:
Never swam before? No problem! These lessons will give you the important foundational skills in swimming and help you be more comfortable in the pool. Learn how to use proper breath control, float, and swim with a kickboard.
Skills Focus:
Being comfortable in the water Learning how to float on your back and front Learning how to kick off the wall with a kickboard Introducing proper breath control in the water Learning how to tread water Learn alternate kicks (Froggy Kick) Being comfortable in the deep end Introducing arms to your strokes
How do I Sign-up?
Registration is not required FREE with a valid Montclair State ID
When and Where?
Student Recreation Center - Pool
Hosted by: Campus Recreation
Additional Information can be found at: https://montclair.campuslabs.com/engage/event/12513509
Source: Montclair State University

item.title: Free Swim Lessons *Intermediate* — Wed Sep 16, 5:00 PM — Student Recreation Center Pool
item.description:
Take your swimming to the next level! Get introduced to new strokes or work on the ones you already know. These lessons are for swimmers who are a little more comfortable in the water but still want to improve their technique and expand what skills they know.
Skills Focus:
Swimming unassisted on your front and back Improve treading (in the deep end) Improving breath control in the water Learn alternate kicks (Dolphin Kick) Introduction to and/or improving your breaststroke Swimming laps Introduction to open and flip turns Introduction to Butterfly
How do I Sign-up?
Registration is not required FREE with a valid Montclair State ID

item.title: Celebrate the publication Shibu's New Friend with author Tess Thomas (recommended for ages 4-8) — Sun Sep 27, 4:00 PM — Montclair Main - Green Room
item.description:
Join author Tess Thomas for a special storytime at the Montclair Public Library! Tess will read her debut picture book, SHIBU'S TAIL, as well as her brand-new sequel, SHIBU'S NEW FRIEND. The books follow the adventures of a cat named Shibu, who has big feelings and an even bigger tail. SHIBU'S TAIL has earned four starred reviews, multiple best-of-year lists, and has been published in over 18 different countries. Following the readings, Tess will answer questions from the audience and lead young readers in a Shibu and Dottie-themed craft. Copies of SHIBU'S TAIL and SHIBU'S NEW FRIEND will be available for purchase and signing following the event.
Registration is recommended but not required.
